verdict.rationale: Slack has threads: its AI can summarize channels and threads (slack-docs-15), and community posts confirm threads exist. However, threading is optional and threads are not named topics. Community reports say Slack encourages posting in the main channel and that threads are hard to use and follow (slack-comm-14, slack-comm-12), so busy channels are not reliably organized under named topics. Missing for 10: mandatory or named topic organization for every conversation, first-party documentation of threading itself, and evidence that threads make catching up efficient.
